description: The contractor shall provide with (1) MBB Caisson Wagon. Scope includes the production and delivery of the wagon to 230 Caisson Circle, Joint Base Myer – Henderson Hall (JBM-HH), VA 22211. At a minimum the wagon must meet all Minimum Essential Characteristics (MECs) that the current Caisson Wagon consist of as well as the salient characteristics outlined in the Statement of Work (SOW) and Purchase Description (PD).
